Data completeness: full month, ~1-mile-radius catchment around Westminster's centre — 2553 recorded incidents for 2026-06. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for that catchment, not a truncated sample — but it's a circle around the borough centre, not the exact administrative boundary, so incidents right at the edges of Westminster may be over- or under-counted. Population used for normalisation: 204,300 residents (2021 census).
